purpose: Engineering smoke test, not a public benchmark. Freeze before Qwen output.
annotation: The coding assistant visually reviewed ordered 1 fps source contact sheets before Qwen inference. Labels are provisional and have not had independent human review. Broad intervals reflect visible action phases, not frame-exact boundaries. One recording and two positive queries cannot establish general quality.

retrieval.metric: Recall@1 with temporal IoU >= 0.3 on the two positive queries
